title: ACE inhibitors in the management of essential hypertension
text: Angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors lower blood pressure by blocking the conversion of angiotensin I to angiotensin II, reducing vasoconstriction and aldosterone-mediated sodium retention. They are recommended as first-line agents in patients with hypertension and comorbid diabetes or chronic kidney disease due to their renoprotective effects, which stem from reduced intraglomerular pressure.
